premises.text: Internet giants invest in global CDN speed and large fraud/abuse teams, but ordinary website operators lack those tools
premises.evidence_span: if you're trying to run a website today, you're left alone without access to any of these tools

premises.text: Cloudflare delivers performance and security tools of the biggest providers to anyone with a website
premises.evidence_span: Cloudflare is a performance and security solution that takes the tools of the biggest service providers and makes them available for anyone with a website online

premises.text: Setup is ridiculously easy: no hardware, software install, or code changes—only a DNS nameserver change in about five minutes

premises.text: Traffic through Cloudflare's global network yields about 30% faster page loads and stops virtually all spam and attacks

premises.text: The service is free at the primary price point while already covering variable costs per user

premises.text: Underlying mechanism is a globally distributed caching proxy with deep packet inspection that can rewrite HTML in real time
